newsitem.title: USA: Catalina to buy back $40 mln in shares.
newsitem.headline: Catalina to buy back $40 mln in shares.

text.p: Catalina Marketing Corp on Monday said its board approved the repurchase of up to $40 million of additional shares of the company's common stock.

The company currently has about 19.6 million shares outstanding. Its shares closed at 39, down 1-1/2, on Monday. The company said the stock will be purchased in the open market and in privately negotiated transactions. The timing of repurchases and number of shares actually repurchased will depend on a variety of factors such as price and other market considerations.

The company, which provides in-store electronic marketing programs for more than 150 consumer goods companies, also announced that it completed its $10 million repurchase program announced in July 1995, including the repurchase of about 130,000 shares at an average price of $44.62 in February and March.

Since September 1994, Catalina Marketing said it has invested about $30 million for the repurchase of about 1.2 million shares, including 227,000 shares acquired under the program announced in July 1995.
